description: Add or remove an emoji reaction to a comment. Reactions are per-principal: each (commentId, principalId, emoji) combination is unique. `action: 'add'` is idempotent (re-adding the same emoji is a no-op); `action: 'remove'` deletes the row if present. Fires `comment.reaction_added` / `comment.reaction_removed`. Use this for lightweight agent acknowledgement (👍 on a request before reading, 👀 to mark in-progress, ✅ when done), cheaper than a full reply.

action.description: Whether to add or remove the reaction. Default `add`.

name: react_to_comment
